mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% (current value 2.33%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% (current value 2.33%) indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% (current value 3.7%) signals economic distress that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2.5% (current value 2.33%) and the unemployment rate is below 4.0% (current value 3.7%), the combination signals a strong economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 AND UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400 (current value 1446.0) and industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 (current value 104.5464), the economy shows strength in both housing and manufacturing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400 AND INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%, current value 3.7%), the labor market is tight, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, current value 2.33%), the accommodative policy supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 (current value 1446.0) signals a weakening housing market, which is associated with reduced consumer confidence and lower corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1400.
